mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4% for two consecutive months indicates a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods when UNRATE is below 4% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 YoY change falls below -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during four consecutive months of INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a dual tightening of monetary policy and rising inflation, which erodes real purchasing power and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals a housing market recovery, which boosts construction-related earnings and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during three consecutive months when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both PAYEMS and UNRATE above their 12-month moving averages signals a synchronized expansion in employment and labor force participation, which increases aggregate demand and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS and UNRATE exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent annualized decline in Real Personal Income (implied by RSAFS and GDPC1) of more than 1% for two consecutive quarters signals weakening household purchasing power, which reduces demand for goods and services and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and GDPC1 jointly imply annualized real income decline > -1% for 2 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during two consecutive quarters of implied real income decline exceeding -1%.
